describe: A playground feel course (docs/PLAYGROUND.md §9.1, PLAN.md WP 13.4): recorded inputs on the gym from a start on its open floor, its numbers against §3.2's references with the body's and the cameras' bounds, and its unit test, which runs it and judges every number as x feel does.
id: the module's path, labs/playground/courses/<name> (its id is course:playground-<name>; node x feel labs/playground --course <name> runs it): labs/playground/courses/stairs
next: make it play and measure what it is for, each number against docs/PLAYGROUND.md §3.2 (node x feel labs/playground --course {{name}} prints them); add its start to labs/playground/courses/courses.test.ts's STARTS and a @see to it there; then node x docs --write
games: this kind makes the playground's courses, on its gym; a game's course is a defineCourse('course:<game>-<name>', …) on one of its own scenes, beside them, and a unit test that expects runCourse(getCourse(id)).pass
